presentation.summary: Manage flammable-liquid truck loading while controlling bonding, ignition sources, overfill protection, SIMOPS and a spill fire.
presentation.role: You are the loading-area safety lead for transfer of a flammable liquid into a tank truck.
presentation.situation: A truck is ready for loading in a hazardous area. Bonding, vehicle condition, overfill protection, vapour control and control of nearby activities must remain effective throughout transfer.
presentation.objective: Prevent ignition and overfill, stop transfer when conditions degrade and manage any spill or fire without exposing personnel.
knownFacts: The loading bay can contain hazardous vapour.
The truck relies on transfer safeguards and overfill protection.
Other vehicle movements can introduce ignition and collision hazards.

loading_authorization_decision_defensibl.observable: The action improves control at the authorize the loading operation stage, but one important verification or scope gap remains. Work proceeds with less assurance.
loading_authorization_decision_defensibl.guidedInsight: This is professionally plausible and partly correct, but it leaves one material criterion unresolved compared with the BEST action.

loading_authorization_decision_weak.observable: Preparation or work continues while a significant control question remains unresolved at the authorize the loading operation stage. The available recovery margin decreases.
loading_authorization_decision_weak.guidedInsight: The action contains a valid element, but sequencing is weak because work advances before the decisive safeguard has been verified.

loading_authorization_decision_best.observable: The team verifies the decisive safeguards at the authorize the loading operation stage before exposure continues. The flammable-liquid loading operation moves forward from a controlled condition.
loading_authorization_decision_best.guidedInsight: The BEST option closes the important uncertainty before work proceeds. It controls the hazard through verification rather than assumption.

loading_authorization_decision_critical.observable: The flammable-liquid loading operation proceeds on an unsupported assumption at the authorize the loading operation stage. A critical safeguard is bypassed and risk escalates sharply.
loading_authorization_decision_critical.guidedInsight: A critical choice often sounds efficient because it relies on prior status, appearance or experience. High-hazard work requires positive verification of the critical barrier.

overfill_decision_defensible.observable: The action improves control at the verify overfill protection stage, but one important verification or scope gap remains. Work proceeds with less assurance.
overfill_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: This is professionally plausible and partly correct, but it leaves one material criterion unresolved compared with the BEST action.

overfill_decision_weak.observable: Preparation or work continues while a significant control question remains unresolved at the verify overfill protection stage. The available recovery margin decreases.
overfill_decision_weak.guidedInsight: The action contains a valid element, but sequencing is weak because work advances before the decisive safeguard has been verified.

overfill_decision_critical.observable: The flammable-liquid loading operation proceeds on an unsupported assumption at the verify overfill protection stage. A critical safeguard is bypassed and risk escalates sharply.
overfill_decision_critical.guidedInsight: A critical choice often sounds efficient because it relies on prior status, appearance or experience. High-hazard work requires positive verification of the critical barrier.

overfill_decision_best.observable: The team verifies the decisive safeguards at the verify overfill protection stage before exposure continues. The flammable-liquid loading operation moves forward from a controlled condition.
overfill_decision_best.guidedInsight: The BEST option closes the important uncertainty before work proceeds. It controls the hazard through verification rather than assumption.

simops_decision_defensible.observable: The team pauses part of the activity and gathers more information, but some exposure or uncertainty remains during the control conflicting activity stage.
simops_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: This choice recognizes the change, yet it leaves a narrower safety margin than a full stop-and-reassess response.

simops_decision_best.observable: The team stops or stabilizes the work when conditions change at the control conflicting activity stage. The new condition is verified before the task continues.
simops_decision_best.guidedInsight: Changing conditions invalidate earlier assumptions. The BEST response creates a deliberate hold point and reassesses the controls before exposure continues.

simops_decision_weak.observable: The work continues under modified monitoring or local precautions even though the control conflicting activity condition has changed materially. Risk begins to rise.
simops_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Extra observation is not equivalent to restoring a failed or uncertain barrier. Changed conditions should be controlled, not merely watched.

simops_decision_critical.observable: The changed condition is effectively accepted and the flammable-liquid loading operation continues. A critical barrier is lost and the scenario moves into emergency territory.
simops_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Proceeding because an alarm limit, schedule or visible condition has not yet become extreme can miss the earlier point where safe intervention was still easy.

spill_fire_decision_best.observable: The team activates the planned emergency response at the respond to spill and ignition stage, keeps people out of the hazard zone and controls the event before re-entry.
spill_fire_decision_best.guidedInsight: The strongest emergency choice protects responders first. Rescue, isolation and source control should follow the planned capability rather than expose another person.

spill_fire_decision_defensible.observable: The immediate area is secured and help is mobilized, but one element of the respond to spill and ignition response remains less complete than the preferred plan.
spill_fire_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: This action can reduce harm, but the BEST response integrates personnel protection, alarm, isolation and planned emergency control without leaving a material response gap.

spill_fire_decision_weak.observable: Some protective action is taken, but personnel remain closer to the hazard than necessary during the respond to spill and ignition response. The margin for a secondary casualty narrows.
spill_fire_decision_weak.guidedInsight: A partial emergency action may sound practical, but it is weak when it keeps people exposed or delays full hazard-zone control.

spill_fire_decision_critical.observable: An unprotected or inadequately controlled intervention is attempted during the respond to spill and ignition stage. The event escalates and a secondary casualty or larger release becomes credible.
spill_fire_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Critical emergency decisions often fail by sending people toward an uncontrolled hazard. Protect responders and establish control before attempting intervention.

closeout_decision_defensible.observable: The team strengthens the immediate controls and uses a controlled restart review, but the closeout does not explore the underlying failure as completely as the BEST path.
closeout_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: Corrective action is valuable, but restart assurance is stronger when the underlying cause and all affected safeguards are verified.

closeout_decision_weak.observable: The team corrects the most visible problem and prepares to resume the flammable-liquid loading operation before the full causal chain has been resolved.
closeout_decision_weak.guidedInsight: A technically acceptable local fix can still be weak if it restores production before learning and system-level corrections are complete.

closeout_decision_best.observable: The flammable-liquid loading operation remains suspended while causes, damaged safeguards and corrective actions are verified. Work is reauthorized only after a safe basis is re-established.
closeout_decision_best.guidedInsight: Safe closeout is not simply returning conditions to normal. It must address why control was lost and verify the barriers needed for a safe restart.

closeout_decision_critical.observable: The flammable-liquid loading operation is pushed toward restart after only superficial recovery. Critical causes or damaged safeguards remain unresolved.
closeout_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Restart pressure can recreate the same hazard. A major event is more likely when work resumes before critical barriers are restored and verified.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The flammable-liquid loading operation was completed with the critical hazards controlled and changing conditions managed before escalation.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: You verified ignition, bonding and transfer safeguards before loading and stopped when conditions changed.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: The flammable-liquid loading operation developed a significant control weakness, but later decisions restored a controlled state before serious harm occurred.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: A loading safeguard weakened, but transfer was secured and control was restored.

incident_contained.title: Incident contained
incident_contained.narrative: The scenario developed into an incident, but emergency and recovery actions contained the event and limited its consequences.
incident_contained.keyTurningPoint: A leak and ignition occurred, but shutdown, evacuation and response limited the event.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control failures allowed the flammable-liquid loading operation to escalate into a major incident requiring extended response, investigation and corrective action.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Transfer and ignition-source weaknesses combined into a major loading-area incident.

critical_failure.title: Critical failure
critical_failure.narrative: The decision path produced a severe uncontrolled outcome in the flammable-liquid loading operation. Recovery options were overwhelmed by a critical barrier failure.
critical_failure.keyTurningPoint: A decisive fire or transfer barrier was bypassed while flammable vapour was present.
